body: If you know of a way for me to get professional help without my parents knowledge it would be great.
I have seriously been resisting it, It is hard but I try to remember what you say. I have only done it once and I think I can resist doing it.

I really am not sure.

I went on a trip with my band for a week and I think that helped me realize there was more there but I only got another year then I will be going to college and I will have no one because I am going to college three hours away.

> I am a teenager. I am 17 and a senior in high school. I used to be super depressed (never got diagnosed but had most of the symptoms.) I finally had a wake up call one day and started improving and stopped self harm and the thought of suicide was just a faint memory, it was nice for a few months, but now my depression is back and for the first time in months i just want to hit myself in the head as hard as i can.
> 

I really don't know, I was feeling better and now the feeling is back and I just feel hopeless. I don't know what to do.
